description.en: Once a month, for a project: read how often each critic's verdict matched the outcome, and when accuracy is under half on four or more verdicts write a prompt proposal. The proposal is stored. The trial flag lp.critic.edit.trial is on unless set off. The gate is the harness bench gate on the nightly set: it holds until that verdict, and the same 14-day deadline retires it when no verdict lands. A prompt is not changed without a passed verdict. No model is called.
description.ru: Раз в месяц по проекту: смотрит, как часто вердикт каждого критика совпал с исходом, и если точность ниже половины на четырёх и более вердиктах, пишет предложение правки промпта. Предложение сохраняется. Флаг испытания lp.critic.edit.trial включён, пока его не выключат. Гейт — тот же бенч харнесса на ночном наборе: держит, пока нет вердикта, и тот же срок в 14 дней снимает испытание, если вердикта нет. Промпт без прошедшего вердикта не меняется. Модель не вызывается.

not_for: changing a critic prompt without a bench
anything a person asks in a chat: Lane Pilot starts this itself on the first day of the month

bench.note: on only when a bench will score the proposal; anything else holds the trial

title.en: Propose a prompt edit from calibration

nodes.rule: code: a proposal when a critic's calibration is low; otherwise skipped. The text is stored and no prompt is edited

title.en: Hold until the nightly bench verdict

nodes.rule: code: judgeSharedTrial on the nightly bench. Wait and retire do not edit a prompt. Adopt lifts the hold and still does not write the prompt in this node

test.live: the critic-edit-monthly cron, or a manual run of lp.critic-edit; the gate stays held while the flag is off
